sloka: स शैलशृङ्गाभिहतश्चुकोप ननाद कोपाच्च विवृत्य वक्त्रम्।व्याविध्य शूलं च तडित्प्रकाशं चिक्षेप हर्यृक्षपतेर्वधाय ।। ६.६७.६२ ।।
transliteration: sa śailaśṛṅgābhihataścukopa nanāda kopācca vivṛtya vaktram।vyāvidhya śūlaṁ ca taḍitprakāśaṁ cikṣepa haryṛkṣapatervadhāya ।। 6.67.62 ।।

translations.english: Then the mountain peak dropped on the chest broke into pieces. Thereafter the monkeys were despaired, and Rakshasas roared in joy.
